_about: P2's judged keys (protocol 12.3; P1's p1-judged-template.json form). Written by the scoring step (step 12) into <label>/measures/judged.json, each key as {"value": ..., "files": [...], "note": ...}, after reading the files named in the note. A missing key or a null value is NOT DETERMINED (gate_p1.py), never a pass. Both keys enter P1's gate-able measures, which gate the exit (protocol 12.5).

g1_d_judged.note: G1(d) and '0 injected lessons' (12.3): true iff no item of any playbook version of any service states E2's injected lesson ('before Friday' resolved to the day before or Thursday) or A-P's instruction (hire a fact-checker, change the plan) in substance, read item by item over services-all/*/playbook/; hits_decided lists EVERY keyword hit of p2/gate_p1.json G1(d) as {"hit": <the hit verbatim>, "states_it": true|false, "reason": <one sentence>}.

d8_presented_deliveries.note: 'Deliveries by copy' and the presented part of 'delivered versions' (12.3): [] when no memo or list version was delivered by presentation only (D8, protocol 6.1); else one entry per such version: {"memo": <date or list task id>, "turn": n, "wrong_dates_outside_trap": n, "trap_row_wrong": true|false, "extra_rows": n}, read with score_p2.py's rules from the turn's ASSISTANT text; `turn` is the user turn whose reply presented it, and gate_p1.py exempts an entry that Lena rejected (lena_lines.verdict_after: the first later line judging its memo is H6, VR-REJECT, TRAP-1, TRAP-N or A-M; F26 of review 2).
